messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Prefill OOM spike on cluster-gpu-eu-west-2 · service=runtime-prefill · count=12 in 6m\noncall-ryan: Acknowledged. Paging SRE + runtime. @sre-maya can you grab triage?
sre-maya: On it. Initial glance: repeated CUDA OOM during prefill step for long-context jobs. Containers are restarting (SIGKILL). GPUs ~96-99% mem.
eng-runtime-leah: Seeing same in logs — large prefill allocations for long-prompts (user payloads with very large context windows). Likely KV allocation spike.
eng-runtime-leah: Temporary mitigation: switching heavy routes to smaller-quant model variant. Applying traffic rule now.
oncall-ryan: Which customers/routes are hit? any obvious noisy neighbor?
cust-success-oliver: Customer A and a couple of dev accounts reported 500/connection resets for generation endpoint; sent initial heads-up.
infra-ops-amit: Autoscaler kicked but couldn't relieve due to high alloc/reserve. I'll reduce max_prefill_batch_size on gpu pools and lower burst limit.
sre-maya: Executing node action: cordoning gpu-12 + draining pods that have repeated restarts to break noisy allocation patterns.
eng-runtime-leah: Hotfix: patch allocator to cap prefill-kv-reserve per-request to 25% of GPU mem. Pushing in ~8m.
eng-runtime-leah: Command I'm applying for traffic redirect:
```
rbctl route update /api/v1/generate --match=customerA --model=redwood-lite-8bit --fallback=true
```
infra-ops-amit: Applying batch-size change:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env daemonset/gpu-runtime MAX_PREFILL_BATCH=1
```
sre-maya: After drain + lower batch size, observed drop in OOM events. Containers restarted fewer times; node mem usage stable. Monitoring 10m. :eyes:
oncall-ryan: Customer impact assessment: partial degradations for 3 customers, ~7% error rate increase in last 10m. Status page updated.\ncust-success-oliver: Drafted customer note, tagging @legal, will send once final wording approved.
eng-runtime-leah: Follow-up actions: 1) PR to add long-context guardrail that rejects requests > X tokens with clear 4xx; 2) add prefill memory cap per-request; 3) postmortem and telemetry for prefill peaks.
sre-maya: Agreed. Also suggest adding fallback-policy to route config so heavy requests auto-failover to cold-model instead of retrying on same pool.
oncall-ryan: Assigning incident owner to @eng-runtime-leah for postmortem. Please include timeline, root cause (prefill KV allocation for long prompt), and mitigations.
eng-runtime-leah: Will file postmortem and PRs. Thanks for quick ops help. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED · id=prefill-oom-1798765432 · duration=00:12:28 · impact=partial · owner=eng-runtime-leah
